google_play.title: Vehicle Maintenance App - Noin
google_play.short_description: Offline vehicle maintenance logbook, service reminders, and resale PDF dossier.
google_play.full_description:
Noin is a local-first vehicle maintenance logbook and service record tracker built for drivers, DIY mechanics, and car enthusiasts who want full data ownership without subscriptions.

Everything is stored locally on your phone in an offline database. No mandatory accounts, no cloud dependency, and no intrusive ads.

KEY FEATURES:

• FAST ONE-TAP LOGGING
Quickly record oil changes, tire rotations, brake jobs, battery replacements, and repairs with dedicated service tiles.

• BUYER-READY RESALE DOSSIER
Export a clean, professional PDF service dossier at the tap of a button. Shows complete chronological service dates, mileage milestones, parts used, and total investment to prove vehicle care and maximize resale value.

• FLEXIBLE VEHICLE PROFILES & CUSTOM PHOTOS
Track any car, truck, classic pre-1981 vehicle, motorcycle, or trailer without forced 17-character VIN restrictions. Upload your own car photos for each bay.

• SMART MAINTENANCE REMINDERS
Set calendar or mileage-based intervals (e.g. 5,000 miles or 6 months). Receive proactive on-device notifications when scheduled service is due.

• 100% OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
Zero cloud trackers, zero location spying, and zero third-party ads. Your garage records remain on your device.

• UNLOCKED CSV EXPORT
Export your complete service history to CSV or JSON anytime. Never get locked out of your own data.

Free for your primary vehicle. Optional lifetime unlock available for multi-vehicle garages.
